n695b6dbfaa.headline: European shares slip; safe-havens gain on attempted Turkish coup
n695b6dbfaa.summary: European shares edged lower and U.S. stocks dipped from record highs after a failed coup attempt in Turkey, while benchmark U.S. Treasury yields eased off three-week highs.
n695b6dbfaa.why: Political instability in Turkey raises geopolitical risks, affecting investor sentiment and causing shifts toward safe-haven assets globally.
n695b6dbfaa.why_moved: The attempted coup in Turkey increased geopolitical risk, prompting investors to reduce equity exposure and seek safe-haven assets like government bonds.
